content.text: {"rows":[{"source_id":"id07431","target":"Затем, подойдя к опущенной шторке, он сказал:"},{"source_id":"id07432","target":"— Приятного вам времяпрепровождения, монсеньор! — сказал он."},{"source_id":"id07433","target":"— Болтун! — крикнул д’Артаньян. — Из-за вас меня выгонят."},{"source_id":"id07434","target":"Шлагбаум заскрипел на петлях; д’Артаньян, увидев, что путь свободен, энергично хлестнул лошадей, и те крупной рысью понеслись вперёд."},{"source_id":"id07435","target":"Через пять минут они догнали карету кардинала."},{"source_id":"id07436","target":"— Мушкетон, — крикнул д’Артаньян, — поднимите шторки на карете Его Величества."},{"source_id":"id07437","target":"— Это он, — сказал Портос."},{"source_id":"id07438","target":"— В кучерах! — воскликнул Мазарини."},{"source_id":"id07439","target":"— Да ещё с каретой коадъютора! — сказала королева."},{"source_id":"id07440","target":"— Corpo di Dio! Монсу д’Артаньян, — сказал Мазарини, — вы стоите своего веса в золоте!"}],"review":[{"source_id":"id07431","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful: approaching the lowered shutter, then speaking. The added 'он сказал' is a natural Russian lead-in to the dialogue line and changes no fact."},{"source_id":"id07432","target":"","verdict":"PASS","reason":"'Bien du plaisir' is rendered idiomatically, the address 'Monseigneur' is correct, and the earlier transliteration error is fixed."},{"source_id":"id07433","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Exclamation, speaker, and the threat of dismissal ('vous me ferez chasser') are preserved; 'Болтун' suits 'Indiscret' in context."},{"source_id":"id07434","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The creaking barrier, the open road, the vigorous whipping and the horses' trot are all kept, in one paragraph."},{"source_id":"id07435","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Five minutes later, the cardinal's carriage was overtaken; the impersonal 'on' is naturally rendered as 'они'."},{"source_id":"id07436","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Command, addressee and 'Sa Majesté' are preserved; dialogue punctuation is correct."},{"source_id":"id07437","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate and complete."},{"source_id":"id07438","verdict":"PASS","reason":"'En cocher' is rendered as 'В кучерах', keeping the exclamation and the speaker."},{"source_id":"id07439","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The prior correction 'с каретой' is confirmed: it follows 'avec le carrosse' and keeps the queen's ironic emphasis."},{"source_id":"id07440","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The prior correction is confirmed: the Italian oath and the Italianized 'monsou' are both italic, and 'вы стоите своего веса в золоте' matches 'vous valez votre pesant d'or'."}]}
